Case study 1 · Enterprise migration

Splitting 18 dealership websites into 36 and recovering 95% of organic traffic in 6 weeks

DealerOn, Dec 2025 to July 2026. General Motors needed its combined Buick GMC dealership sites separated into independent brand sites, turning 18 websites into 36. I worked on the migration as part of a five-member SEO team supported by external contractors.

The challenge: every URL on a combined site had to land on the right brand site, with no cross-brand content left behind and no loss of rankings during the switch.
18combined Buick GMC dealership websites
→
36independent brand websites
280+

301 redirects mapped

190+

Internal links corrected

45+

404 errors resolved

12

New GBPs, live from day one

0

Manual penalties

What the work covered

  • Audited the 18 combined sites and mapped every URL
  • Removed cross-brand references from content, metadata, and schema
  • Rebuilt internal linking for each brand site
  • Set up GA4, Search Console, and BrightLocal for every new site
  • Built 30+ citations and earned 15+ referring domains in 60 days

Results

  • 95% of pre-migration organic traffic recovered within 6 weeks
  • Clicks fully stabilized within 8 weeks
  • Zero critical crawl errors remaining
  • Core Web Vitals within passing thresholds
